gloss: to value; to respect; to attach importance to

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {重|おも}んじていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to value; to respect; to attach importance to
definitions.explanation: To regard something as important or worthy of respect. Used for abstract concepts like traditions, principles, and values rather than physical objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重|おも}んじる。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重|おも}んじて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This company values the opinions of its employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重|おも}んじる⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should aim for a society that respects individual freedom.

notes:
An ichidan verb derived from ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧ (heavy, important). An older variant {重|おも}んずる also exists and conjugates as a mixed verb (ずる-verb), but {重|おも}んじる is the standard modern form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重|おも}んじる (to value tradition)
- ⟦{礼儀|れいぎ}→礼儀：03780_reigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重|おも}んじる (to value manners)
- ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重|おも}んじる (to respect human rights)
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重|おも}んじる (to value opinions)
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重|おも}んじる (to value honor)

A formal, written-style verb. More elevated than ⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧ (to treat as important) or ⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧ (to respect). Typically used with abstract nouns like traditions, values, rights, and principles.
